title: Count Inversions using BIT
statement:
Given an array of N distinct integers, count the number of inversions.

An inversion is a pair (i, j) such that i < j but A[i] > A[j].

Use a Fenwick Tree (BIT) with coordinate compression for an O(N log N) solution.
inputFormat:
The first line contains N.
The second line contains N space-separated integers.
outputFormat: A single integer: the number of inversions.
constraints:
1 <= N <= 10^5
-10^6 <= A[i] <= 10^6
All elements are distinct.

examples.explanation: Fully reversed array has N*(N-1)/2 = 10 inversions.
